Notes

The frame is part of the story. Flat 1.85 sits close to the 16:9 of a laptop screen, while Scope 2.39 trades height for width, which suits landscapes and people sharing a shot. Narrow the frame to 4:3 and the lighthouse on the right drops out of the picture.

The bars move on a spring rather than a fixed curve, so every change, even mid-drag, reads as one continuous motion.
